user.title: Set up Met Office Weather Warnings
user.description: Uses the official Met Office regional severe-weather warning feed. Area filtering is best-effort and matches text present in the feed.

data_description.area_filters: Optional comma-separated text, for example Nottingham, Nottinghamshire. A warning is kept when any term appears in the feed item. Leave blank for every warning in the selected region.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Met Office Weather Warnings
reconfigure.description: Change the region and warning filters.

abort.already_configured: This Met Office region is already configured.

init.title: Met Office Weather Warnings options
init.description: Change local filtering and polling without changing the configured region.

data_description.area_filters: Optional comma-separated text. A warning is kept when any term appears in the feed item.
